text.서로 링크된 마크다운 페이지를 보고 고치고 링크 관계·기록을 본다: View and edit linked Markdown pages and see their links and history
Limits for wiki zip imports (read without extracting to disk).
Maximum size of the zip file itself.
Raise this when moving a large wiki.
Maximum number of files and folders in one zip.
Raise this when there are a great many pages.
Maximum uncompressed size of one file in the zip.
Raise this together with the page size limit.
Maximum total uncompressed size of all files in the zip.
text.검색 색인 기본값입니다. 사용자 설정에서 검색 방식을 고르면 그쪽이 먼저: Search index defaults. A search method picked in the user settings comes first.
text.설치된 검색 방식 중 기본으로 쓸 이름. 없는 이름이면 대체 방식을 쓰고: Name of the installed search method to use by default. If the name doesn't exist, the fallback method is used and you're told.
Change this when you install a search plugin and want it as the default.
text.기본 검색 방식을 쓸 수 없을 때 쓸 방식. 비우면 검색 색인 없이 동작: Method used when the default search method isn't available. Leave empty to work without a search index.
Set this to change or turn off the fallback method.
How the search index splits words (a value the index implementation reads).
Change this only if the search implementation accepts another tokenizer.
text.검색 방식 이름 → 그 방식이 받는 옵션(키는 검색 구현이 정한다, 예:: Search method name → the options that method takes (the search implementation defines the keys, for example token_pattern). Only the options of the method in use are passed.
text.설치한 검색 구현이 낱말 규칙 같은 추가 옵션을 받을 때 정하세요. 대소: Set this when the installed search implementation takes extra options such as word rules. Case-insensitivity and the result limit are set by the app and don't change.
Storage location, names and limits of the wiki feature (server administrator values).
text.위키 정의를 저장하는 정의 종류의 이름. 바꾸면 이미 있는 위키를 찾지: Name of the definition kind that stores wiki definitions. If changed, existing wikis can't be found.
text.위키 규칙을 저장하는 정의 종류의 이름. 바꾸면 이미 있는 규칙을 찾지: Name of the definition kind that stores wiki rules. If changed, existing rules can't be found.
text.저장 공간(프로젝트 구성 폴더 또는 단독 루트) 안에서 위키 정의를 두는: Folder for wiki definitions inside the storage space (project config folder or standalone root).
Folder for wiki rules inside the storage space.
text.저장 공간 안에서 위키 페이지를 두는 폴더(그 아래 위키마다 폴더 하나): Folder for wiki pages inside the storage space (one folder per wiki below it).
text.프로젝트 연동이 없을 때 위키를 두는 폴더. 비우면 워크스페이스 안 기본: Folder for wikis when there's no projects integration. Leave empty for the default folder in the workspace. Relative paths are resolved from the settings file folder.
Set this to change the storage location when you use only the wiki without projects.
Match this only if you changed the space name prefix of the records integration.
Maximum content size of one page. Larger writes are refused and left out of the index.
Raise this when you need to write very long pages.
text.위키 하나에 둘 수 있는 최대 페이지 수. 넘으면 나머지는 색인하지 않고: Maximum number of pages in one wiki. Above it, the rest aren't indexed and you're told.
Raise this when you use a very large wiki.
text.페이지 하나의 링크를 찾는 최대 시간. 넘으면 그 페이지의 링크만 빼고: Maximum time to find the links of one page. Above it, only that page's links are left out and you're told.
Raise this when large pages get cut off on a slow computer.
text.바뀌지 않은 페이지를 다시 읽지 않도록 위키마다 보관할 페이지 수. 0이: Number of pages kept per wiki so unchanged pages aren't read again. 0 turns this off.
Lower this when you want to use less memory.
text.위키 목록 카드 값(페이지·끊긴 링크·점검 수)을 다시 계산하지 않도록: Number of wikis whose list card values (pages, broken links, checks) are kept so they aren't recalculated. Recalculated when page files change.
Raise this when there are a great many wikis.
Maximum number of nodes shown at once in the link graph.
Raise this when you want to see the whole graph of a large wiki.
Maximum results returned by one search.
text.에이전트 위키 검색 이벤트에 남길 검색어 해시. 솔트 HMAC은 원문을: Hash of the search query kept in agent wiki search events. Salted HMAC makes the original hard to guess, sha256 gives the same value across installs, and off keeps only the length.
Name of the environment variable to read the salted HMAC salt from (the value isn't kept in the settings). If empty, or if the variable is empty, a new random salt is used each time the server starts. You can use the same variable as memory.
Maximum lines returned at once by the recent changes list.
text.열어 본 위키의 페이지 파일을 이 주기마다 다시 읽어 앱 밖 변경을 기록: Rereads the page files of opened wikis at this interval to record changes made outside the app. 0 checks only when reading and on [Rescan].
Set this when you often edit with another editor and want the history updated right away.
text.페이지 폴더·위키 정의·규칙·설정을 확인한 뒤 이 시간 안에는 다시 확인: After checking the page folder, wiki definitions, rules and settings, they aren't checked again within this time. 0 checks on every request.
text.앱 안에서 한 변경은 바로 보이고, 다른 편집기로 고친 파일만 최대 이만: Changes made in the app show right away; only files edited in another editor can show up to this much later ([Rescan] checks right away). If the screen is slow on a slow drive or a wiki with thousands of pages, raise it to 10–30 seconds; set 0 to always see changes from other editors right away.
Change this when you install a search plugin.
Raise this when you need to move a large wiki.
